title: proto-forge configuration (api-java template)
description: Merged over the built-in strict defaults and any ~/.config/proto-forge/config.json. Run `pnpm config:show` to see what is actually in force and where each value came from. Anything omitted keeps its strict default — this file only records deviations.

policy.description: Documentation of intent. Enforcement comes from gates[].mode and waivers[], not from this field.

gates.description: Per-gate settings. Tightening is always allowed. Relaxing a mandatory gate (the MANDATORY_GATES list in scripts/config.mjs — arch, contract, errors, migration, opid, docs, security, stub, consistency, snapshot, coverage, ignores, mutation, external, log, deps) below "error" additionally requires a live waivers[] entry — without one, config:check fails AND the gate runs at "error" regardless of what is written here.

dryRun.description: true (default) writes payloads to .proto-forge/outbox/ and contacts nothing. Live writes happen via `pnpm sync:jira --commit`, or unattended via `pnpm sync:auto` when autoPropagate is on.

autoPropagate.description: Standing, reviewed consent for unattended live writes: `pnpm sync:auto` (run by the pipeline after each accepted ADR and at release) sends without a per-run --approve. Stands in for --approve ONLY — enabled, dryRun:false, the network allowlist and credentials are still required.

createFor.description: Which pipeline events produce a ticket payload.

tokenEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API token. Never the token itself.

autoPropagate.description: Standing, reviewed consent for unattended live publishes via `pnpm sync:auto`. Stands in for --approve only; all other requirements remain.

requireApproval.description: Outward-facing effects an operator must confirm interactively, e.g. "jira.create", "confluence.publish".

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns an agent hook refuses to edit — the byte-pinned platform kernel, the locks, the append-only prompt log.

freezeThresholds.description: Refuse edits that would lower a coverage threshold or a mutation floor. Overridable for one command with PROTO_FORGE_ALLOW_THRESHOLD_EDIT=1.

waivers.description: The only way to relax a mandatory gate. Each entry expires; after that the gate enforces again on its own.

reason.description: What the relaxation buys and why the risk is acceptable.

adr.description: Number of an ADR that exists in docs/adr/.

mode.description: error = fails the build. warn = prints findings and passes. off = does not enforce.
